business_description: GE Vernova Inc. is a global energy equipment, services, and software company formed from the separation of General Electric's energy businesses. The company provides gas, steam, nuclear, hydro, and wind power generation technologies, grid equipment and systems, and electrification software and services for utilities, independent power producers, grid operators, governments, and large industrial customers. Its business is tied to power generation investment, grid modernization, energy security, electrification, and the build-out of lower-carbon energy infrastructure.
business_model: GE Vernova sells large-scale power generation and grid equipment, wind turbines, related installation/project work, long-cycle services, spare parts, upgrades, and software. The model combines cyclical original-equipment sales with recurring and higher-margin service revenue from a large installed base. Profitability depends on project execution, equipment pricing, mix between equipment and services, supply-chain discipline, warranty costs, and demand for gas power, renewables, and grid infrastructure.
